vectorId.description: Unique identifier for the vector in the vector store.

rank.description: The rank given by the vector store search.

distance.description: The distance given by the vector store search.

content.description:
The content corresponding to the embedding found in the vector store.
This is the object that was embedded.
For example, it could be the document content as a string.

title:
Represents a single search result from similarity search.
This is returned from {@link GenaiCore.VectorStore#similaritySearch}.
name: GenaiCore.VectorStore.SimilaritySearchResult
